    - Transliterate: accents/diacritics to ASCII equivalents (é→e, ñ→n)
    - Preserve: CJK, emoji, math symbols (other datasets may need them)

    drop_categories = {'Cc', 'Cf', 'Cs', 'Co', 'Cn'}

    drop_chars = {
        '\u202c',  # RIGHT-TO-LEFT MARK
        '\u202a', '\u202b', '\u202d', '\u202e',  # other bidi controls
        '\u200b', '\u200c', '\u200d',  # zero-width joiners
        '\ufeff',  # zero-width no-break space
    }
    
    cleaned = []
    for char in value:

        # Then drop the combining mark, leaving base ASCII where possible
        decomposed = unicodedata.normalize('NFD', char)

    # This is your safety net—replaces any unsupported chars with '?'

    return result

        '…': '...',            # ellipsis
    }

    # Remove combining marks (accents, diacritics)

    # Drop control chars, format chars, directional marks
    s = ''.join(
        c for c in s 
        if unicodedata.category(c)[0] not in ('C', 'Z')  # C=control, Z=separator
    )
    
    return s
